verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own surfaces turned away a standard identified user agent: ohiosos.gov returned HTTP 403 at robots.txt, and the Ohio Business Central filing portal also returned 403, flapping to 404, so no readable crawl policy exists on that host. The pages that did load (gateway.ohio.gov, tax.ohio.gov) belong to other state agencies, not the SoS's guidance pages, so they don't show the SoS reading surface is reachable. Confidence is medium because only robots.txt was fetched, not the guidance pages themselves.
